grandmother.definition: The mother of your father or mother.

grandfather.definition: The father of your father or mother.

grandma.definition: The mother of your father or mother.

grandpa.definition: The father of your father or mother.

great-grandmother.definition: A person’s great-grandmother is the mother of one of their grandparents, placing her two generations earlier in the family line.

great-grandfather.definition: The male parent of a person's grandparent, making him that person's ancestor three generations back.

nana.definition: People may call a caring older woman Nana, even when she is not their grandmother.

papa.definition: An informal term for a father.

granny.definition: The mother of your father or mother.

grandparent.definition: A parent of your father or mother.

aunt.definition: The sister of your father or mother.

uncle.definition: The brother of your father or mother.

cousin.definition: The child of your aunt or uncle.
cousin.arabicTranslation: ابن أو ابنة العم أو الخال

first-cousin.arabicTranslation: ابن أو ابنة العم أو الخال أول
first-cousin.definition: The child of a person's aunt or uncle.

second-cousin.arabicTranslation: ابن أو ابنة العم أو الخال الثاني
second-cousin.definition: A person who shares great-grandparents with someone else.

great-aunt.definition: The sister of a person's grandparent.

great-uncle.definition: A male relative who is the sibling of someone’s grandparent, two generations above them in a family tree.

niece.definition: A daughter of your brother or sister.

nephew.definition: A son of your brother or sister.

cousin-in-law.definition: A relative related through marriage to a person's cousin or spouse.

mother-in-law.definition: The mother of someone's spouse, making her a relative connected through marriage rather than birth.

father-in-law.definition: The parent of someone's spouse, who becomes a relative through marriage.

sister-in-law.definition: A female spouse of someone’s brother or sister.

brother-in-law.definition: In broader family usage, a man may become a relative through remarriage or an unusual family connection, such as being married to your spouse's sibling or being the brother of your sibling's spouse.

son-in-law.definition: A daughter's husband, viewed as a male relative gained through marriage.

daughter-in-law.definition: A woman married to a person's son, regarded in relation to that parent as a family member.

in-laws.definition: Relatives connected to you through marriage, especially your spouse’s parents and other close family members.

spouse-s-family.definition: The relatives of a person's husband or wife.

extended-in-laws.definition: Relatives connected through marriage beyond immediate in-laws.

family-in-law.definition: The family members gained through marriage.

reunion.definition: A party of former associates who have come together again.

holiday-dinner.definition: A special meal shared with family or friends on a holiday.

thanksgiving.definition: Fourth Thursday in November in the United States.

christmas.definition: A Christian holiday celebrating the birth of Christ.

easter.definition: A Christian celebration of the Resurrection of Christ.

birthday-celebration.definition: An event held to mark the day someone was born.

anniversary.definition: The date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it).

barbecue.definition: To cook outdoors on a barbecue grill.

picnic.definition: Eating a meal outdoors, often on a blanket or table.

family-wedding.definition: A marriage ceremony attended by relatives of the couple.
